topic: GAO 2006: deadline extensions and proposed exemptions

claim: Under 15 U.S.C. 78u-6, added by the Dodd-Frank Act in 2010, when a whistleblower voluntarily gives the SEC original information that leads to a successful SEC action with sanctions over $1 million, the SEC must pay an award totaling 10 to 30 percent of the money collected (shared if there is more than one whistleblower).
